verdict.rationale: Stagehand's core primitives are built around natural-language instructions: act() for plain-English actions with no selectors, extract() and observe() taking instructions, and agent() for fully autonomous high-level tasks. Its MCP integration also lets users control browsers with commands like "click the login button," and community users confirm the self-healing, dynamically generated approach is useful. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of how reliably natural-language commands succeed across varied sites.
